methodology.how: THE SHIM: identical to comp-trace's four lines -- WORKSPACE derived from its own path; `python $WORKSPACE/org/modules/graph/iam_cli.py "$@"`; `_exit=$?`; `comp_log_auto.py "comp-iam" "$*" $_exit 2>/dev/null`; `exit $_exit`. THE DELEGATE (iam_cli.py, read at :1-30, :27-60, :887-960, :1020-1070, :1123-1135, :1228-1240, :1501-1624; extract_iam.py read at :1-30 and its method->action tables :196-483): build_iam_report(_WORKSPACE) parses (1) infra/aws/lambda/ci/lambda-source-map.json (function -> source dir), (2) infra/aws/terraform/*/iam.tf (role policies), (3) the Lambda .py sources for boto3 client calls, (4) data/black_diamond/scripts/gold/*.py for boto3 + aws CLI, (5) infra/aws/ec2/EC2_MANIFEST.json (EC2 service -> role); the boto3 method -> IAM action mapping is a hand-maintained whitelist per service (s3, ssm, dynamodb, secretsmanager, ec2, lambda, sns, stepfunctions, cloudfront, cloudwatch, ses, events, iam, logs, sts, sqs, rds, cloudtrail, ce, kms), and a client outside it prints COVERAGE-UNKNOWN with the service names (:122). `gaps` (the default) runs BOTH planes per call site since 2026-08-11 -- action gaps (missing / deny-present / coverage-unknown) and resource verdicts -- and keeps rc 0 as an INFORMATIONAL surface; `resource-sweep` is the rc-GATING form (exit 1 if any call is flagged). `reconcile` / `live` overlay the APPLIED plane from a dated census / comp-aws derive and REFUSE past a TTL (24 h census; derive TTL from comp_iam_live.DEFAULT_DERIVE_TTL_HOURS) rather than guess; `simulate` calls iam simulate-principal-policy for ONE (role, action, resource) with a positive control; two OFFLINE self-test suites (`census-self-test`, `simulate-self-test`) exercise the vintage/fail-closed and mutant arms with no AWS. EXERCISED at carding (no AWS call made): `comp-iam stats` rc 0; `comp-iam census-self-test` -> 'OK: all census self-test cases pass' rc 0 (incl. 'the real 2026-06-03 census age -> STALE'); `comp-iam simulate-self-test` -> 'OK: all simulate self-test cases pass' rc 0; `comp-iam gaps` rc 0 with the two-plane banner and totals; `comp-iam resource-sweep` rc 1 (flagged candidates present) with its own caveat text ('an UNRESOLVABLE resource is not a pass'; 'a FLAGGED call is a CANDIDATE, not a failure'). Every run landed as a row in the live sink.

key.identity_space: Three joined spaces: IAM ACTIONS ('s3:GetObject'), derived from boto3 method names by the whitelist; IAM ROLES, named by Terraform resource and matched to Lambda functions (source map) and EC2 services (manifest); RESOURCE ARNs, parsed from the call site's arguments where literal, else UNRESOLVABLE. The census keys roles by name and stamps an account id.
key.key_expression: ACTION KEY: boto3 client service + method -> the whitelist row (extract_iam.py:196-483), one method may map to several actions; a method absent -> COVERAGE-UNKNOWN. ROLE KEY: function name -> source dir (lambda-source-map.json) -> the role the function's Terraform attaches; service -> role via EC2_MANIFEST.json. RESOURCE KEY: the literal bucket/table/ARN in the call arguments against each Allow statement's Resource (pattern-aware; '*' = GRANTED-BROAD, excluded not cleared). VINTAGE KEY: census _meta.generated_utc against now, TTL 24 h -> FRESH / STALE / FUTURE / NO_VINTAGE (fail-closed). LOG KEY: the collapsed `$*` string + 30 s dedup.
key.declared_mapping: The five sources and the three verdict planes are declared in the engine header and the CLI docstring; the whitelist is declared as a whitelist (:376). comp-iam's OWN registry entry is tool_index.py:1115-1125 (id cloud.iam.permission_gaps; anti_pattern 'comp-aws derive to reason about a single role's grants'; canonical_call 'comp-iam gaps # or: comp-iam service <lambda> | comp-iam role <name>'; cost '~2s'; freshness 'live TF state + code scan (no Kuzu dependency)'; rebuild_trigger 'n/a -- this is the canonical IAM-gap path') -- nothing in it is stale. The stale proposition lives in the ADJACENT entry: comp-iam-usage's anti_pattern at :1126-1129 describes comp-iam as '(DESIRED, (action)-not-(action,resource))' -- a description of THIS tool written on ANOTHER tool's row, and it predates the 2026-08-11 two-plane fix (@c2f70f7ca4): `gaps` does compare the resource now. verdict.why: The most-used and the most honest of the three shims on this face: 275 runs in the live sink (28 in the last 14 days), and a delegate that prints its denominator in both planes with the holes NAMED -- unresolvable resources counted not cleared, broad grants excluded not cleared, role-unmapped calls printed as a hole, unmodeled boto3 services printed by name, stale censuses refused with the age -- and two offline self-test suites that pass at carding, one of which tests that the tool's own default census is stale. The shim does its four jobs and shares comp-trace's stderr-discard and $*-rendering defects (one template, one commit). QUALIFIED on four measured points. FIRST: the APPLIED plane has been refusing-by-design for 24.6 days -- the newest census (2026-08-05) is STALE against the 24 h TTL and the declared refresher has not been run; `gaps` on the default path is the DESIRED plane only, so a console-made or AWS-managed grant is currently invisible to every mode that will run. SECOND: three of four resource verdicts are UNRESOLVABLE (620 of 825) -- correctly declared, but it means the two-plane fix verdicts one call in four. THIRD: the registry is stale in the tool's favour on an ADJACENT row -- comp-iam-usage's anti_pattern (tool_index.py:1126-1129) still describes comp-iam as '(action)-not-(action,resource)', a limit the 2026-08-11 fix removed (comp-iam's own entry, :1115-1125, is not stale); and `_DEFAULT_CENSUS` (:887) names a default the code no longer uses. FOURTH: the shim's `2>/dev/null` discards the logger's last-resort drop disclosure. Beside these, the sibling-module scan hole is declared by the CLI (iam_cli.py:564, :642-644) and carried as declared; the gold-tree scope (black_diamond only, per the header) is READ not verified and the card says so.
